karakeep.notes:
# Karakeep

Bookmarks API under `/karakeep/`.

- `GET /karakeep/bookmarks` lists bookmarks.
- `GET /karakeep/bookmarks/search?q=<text>` searches them.
- `POST /karakeep/bookmarks` with `{"type":"link","url":"..."}` adds one.

Reads need `karakeep.read`. Other methods need `karakeep.full`.

openrouter.notes:
# OpenRouter

OpenAI-compatible model API under `/openrouter/`.

- `GET /openrouter/models` lists models (needs `openrouter.read`).
- `POST /openrouter/chat/completions` with `{"model":"<id>","messages":[...]}` runs a model and spends credit (needs `openrouter.full`).

context7.notes:
# Context7

Remote MCP server for library docs (tools `resolve-library-id`, `query-docs`), reached through speaker at `/context7` (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC over POST). Listing and read-only tools need `context7.read`.

parallel-search.notes:
# Parallel Web Search

Remote MCP server (tools `web_search`, `web_fetch`) reached through speaker at `/parallel-search`. `web_fetch` can read any page, so ask for it only when the task needs it.
